readPinterestApi.summary: Read Pinterest API v5 (boards, board sections, Pins)
readPinterestApi.description:
Calls Pinterest API v5 with the connection of profile `user`: `{endpoint}` is the path of Pinterest's own reference (developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5) without the leading slash, with the same query parameters and JSON body. Boards, board sections and Pins: the operations below. Every parameter and body field is checked against Pinterest's description before calling Pinterest (`invalid_parameter` / `invalid_body`). `data` is Pinterest's answer as is.

To create, save or delete Pins use `/upload`, `/upload_photos`, `/uploadposts/posts/save` and `/uploadposts/posts/unpublish` (plan limits and history).

Reads are cached per account (60 s; `refresh=true` skips the cache) and count against a daily read limit per Upload-Post account; a write through this route drops the cached reads of the account. Deletes need `confirm=true`. An operation that needs a Pinterest permission the connection did not grant answers `403` `pinterest_reconnect_required` (reconnect Pinterest), with `missing_scopes`, without calling Pinterest.

| method | Pinterest path | Pinterest permissions | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /boards | boards:read | - |
| POST | /boards | boards:read, boards:write | - |
| DELETE | /boards/{board_id} | boards:read, boards:write | confirm=true |
| GET | /boards/{board_id} | boards:read | - |
| PATCH | /boards/{board_id} | boards:read, boards:write | - |
| GET | /boards/{board_id}/pins | boards:read, pins:read | - |
| GET | /boards/{board_id}/sections | boards:read | - |
| POST | /boards/{board_id}/sections | boards:read, boards:write | - |
| DELETE | /boards/{board_id}/sections/{section_id} | boards:read, boards:write | confirm=true |
| PATCH | /boards/{board_id}/sections/{section_id} | boards:read, boards:write | - |
| GET | /boards/{board_id}/sections/{section_id}/pins | boards:read, pins:read | - |
| GET | /pins | boards:read, pins:read | - |
| GET | /pins/{pin_id} | boards:read, pins:read | - |

params.endpoint: Pinterest API v5 path without the leading slash, e.g. `boards`, `boards/123/pins`, `boards/123/sections`, `pins/456`.

readX.description:
One read-only X API call per request, with the fields fixed by Upload-Post. `data`, `includes` and `meta` are X's own objects. Answers are cached for a few minutes per account (trends 15 min, analytics 1 h): repeating the call within that time costs nothing (`cached: true`). Pagination: pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor`. Kinds that need an X permission (liking_users, reposts_of_me, bookmarks, followers, following and the list kinds) need an X account connected or reconnected on or after 2026-11-25; otherwise the API answers `403` `x_reconnect_required`.

| kind | X endpoint | X permission | X price | X rate limit (15 min) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| search_recent | GET /2/tweets/search/recent (`query`, last 7 days) | - | $0.005/post + $0.010/author | 300 per account |
| counts_recent | GET /2/tweets/counts/recent (`query`, `granularity`) | - | $0.005/request | 300 per app |
| liking_users | GET /2/tweets/{post_id}/liking_users | like.read | $0.010/user | 75 |
| reposted_by | GET /2/tweets/{post_id}/retweeted_by | - | $0.010/user | 75 |
| quote_posts | GET /2/tweets/{post_id}/quote_tweets (`exclude`) | - | $0.005/post + $0.010/author | 75 |
| reposts_of_me | GET /2/users/reposts_of_me | timeline.read | $0.005/post + $0.010/author | - |
| bookmarks | GET /2/users/{id}/bookmarks | bookmark.read | $0.005/post + $0.010/author | 180 |
| followers, following | GET /2/users/{id}/followers, /following (max 100 per page here) | follows.read | $0.010/user | 300 |
| owned_lists, followed_lists, pinned_lists | GET /2/users/{id}/owned_lists, /followed_lists, /pinned_lists | list.read | $0.005/list | 15 |
| list, list_posts, list_members, list_followers | GET /2/lists/{list_id}[/tweets, /members, /followers] | list.read | $0.005/list, $0.005/post, $0.010/user | 75 / 900 |
| trends | GET /2/trends/by/woeid/{woeid} (`limit` = max_trends, 1-50) | - | $0.010/request | 75 per app |
| trend_locations | GET /2/trends/locations | - | $0.010/request (cached 24 h for everyone) | - |
| personalized_trends | GET /2/users/personalized_trends | - | $0.010/request | 10 (100 per 24 h) |
| post_analytics | GET /2/tweets/analytics (`ids` up to 100, `start_time`, `end_time`, `granularity`) | - | not published by X; counted as $0.005 per post | 300 |
| media_analytics | GET /2/media/analytics (`media_keys` up to 100, `start_time`, `end_time`, `granularity`) | - | not published by X; counted as $0.005 per media | - |

manageXLists.description: Needs the X permission list.write: the X account must have been connected or reconnected on or after 2026-11-25, otherwise the API answers `403` `x_reconnect_required`. Each call counts toward the daily X write limit shared with replies, edits, reposts and likes. X price: list create $0.010, list manage $0.005. X rate limit: 300 per 15 min per account. Read lists with `GET /uploadposts/x/read/owned_lists` and `list_members`.

_comment_production: Production (2026-11-25): 'excluded' leaves out every operation that is off in production; 'available' lists the ones switched on there although the spec still marks them not generally available; 'hidden_fields' and 'descriptions' keep fields and texts of features that are off out of the SDK.
